purpose: Exploratory representation iteration after the absolute-level comparison failed to generalize between runs.

normal_drift_analysis.population: All pure normal windows in each split, reported by service and original feature.
statistics: absolute median displacement divided by the train IQR, with train standard deviation and 1.0 as fallbacks
normal_drift_analysis.role: Diagnostic evidence only; no threshold in this analysis selects a model or changes the preregistered representation.

local_reference.known_normal_source: The first pure-normal period identified by the experiment phase schedule.
local_reference.duration_interpretation: Eighteen starts at a ten-second step span 170 seconds; their thirty-second source windows collectively cover 200 seconds.
local_reference.exclusion: Reference rows are excluded from model fitting, score calibration, hyperparameter selection, threshold selection and evaluation.
local_reference.operational_assumption: A future run provides a declared normal calibration period before monitoring the condition of interest.

representation.base_transform: Apply log1p to the same non-negative magnitudes used by detector_comparison_v1.
representation.reference_center: Per-run, per-service median over the eighteen reference rows.
representation.reference_scale: Per-run, per-service IQR; use reference standard deviation if the IQR is zero or invalid, then 1.0 if both are zero or invalid.
representation.imputation: Replace a missing value with its local reference median; use 0 when the feature is absent throughout the local reference.

components.local_level: Current imputed value minus the local reference median, divided by the local reference scale.
components.causal_change: Current imputed value minus the immediately preceding chronological value for the same run and service, divided by the local reference scale; use zero only when no predecessor exists.

comparison.score_calibration: Empirical percentile by service fitted only on non-reference train-normal rows.
comparison.threshold_selection: Best validation F1 with false positives as the tie-breaker.
comparison.test_policy: Do not inspect test outcomes until every algorithm and feature-set variant has been selected with validation. Evaluate the frozen selections once.
comparison.decision_policy: Do not select an algorithm automatically. Interpret system detection, affected-service detection and localization jointly, and require new independent runs for confirmatory selection.
